text:
```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run CI with Turbo
        run: pnpm turbo ci --filter=^!(ui) --log-level=info --reporter=detailed --summary

      - name: Upload coverage reports
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: "**/*.lcov"
          directory: "coverage"

      - name: Cancel previous workflow runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow_id }}
          access_token: ${{ github.token }}
          all_but_latest: true
```
